card.title: Brighter Side
card.instruction: Meet every setback with even greater optimism.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our show sold no tickets. We can rehearse uninterrupted.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The theatre's cancelled us. I'm asking for our deposit back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better! We'll hire the pub upstairs. People already go there voluntarily.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've kept the deposit. All we can afford is the bus home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful—a touring production! I'll carry the scenery; you bring exact change. We can try the opening scene between stops.

mechanism: A responds to progressively worse show prospects with increasingly expansive positive performance opportunities.
confusable: Unlike practical adaptation alone, each actual setback must produce greater enthusiasm in A's next choice.
comparison: D20-b becomes a bus touring production; D20-a is a protected historical exception and is not reopened.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
